GCould vs Used to · Ability or habit? Choose the correct expression.

  1. 1

    (Ability) At ten, Ece solve difficult maths problems without help.

  2. 2

    (Habit) Arda play chess every evening, but he rarely plays now.

  3. 3

    (Inability) I understand spoken French before my first course.

  4. 4

    (Former state) Our street be much quieter before the shops opened.

  5. 5

    (Ability) Duru draw accurate portraits at the age of nine.

  6. 6

    (No past habit) We check our phones during meals, but we do now.

  7. 7

    (Past habit question) your father use to work at the old factory?

  8. 8

    (Ability question) your grandmother swim when she was young?

  9. 9

    (Former state) My brother have curly hair, but it is straight now.

  10. 10

    (Inability) Eren read the board without his glasses.

  11. 11

    (Habit) My cousins spend every summer at our farm.

  12. 12

    (Ability) Mert play the guitar beautifully as a teenager.

  13. 13

    (No past habit) Selin eat breakfast regularly, but she does now.

  14. 14

    (Ability question) you type quickly before your computer course?

HCould / Used to · Complete the texts. Use could, couldn’t, used to or didn’t use to.

couldcouldn’tused todidn’t use to

Ece’s grandfather

When Ece’s grandfather was a child, he (1) walk to school every day, but he drives now. He (2) have a tablet; he got his first one much later. He was a talented musician and (3) play the violin very well. He (4) send video messages because his family had no internet connection. His school days (5) begin at eight, but today the school starts at nine.

Duru’s childhood

Duru (6) live in a small village, but she moved to the city. At first, she (7) swim at all, so she needed lessons. After two years of practice, she (8) swim very well. She (9) wear glasses, but she needs them now. Her family (10) visit the river every weekend, but they no longer do.

Mert and his sister

Mert (11) be very shy, but he is confident now. At the age of seven, he (12) ride a bicycle without help; he learned much later. His older sister was good at art and (13) paint beautiful landscapes. They (14) share a bedroom, but now each has a room. Mert (15) read storybooks every night, but he now prefers audiobooks.
